component_name: Direct Air Capture (DAC) — Liquid Solvent (KOH/Ca caustic loop)
source: Keith et al. (2018) Joule 2(8) 1573-1594 (Carbon Engineering); Sabatino et al. (2021) Joule 5(8) 2047-2076; Holmes & Keith (2012) Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 370 4380-4403

unit.name: 1 MtCO2/yr Carbon Engineering-style KOH/Ca caustic-loop DAC module

area_contactor_m2.note: Total contactor frontal area (Keith 2018: ~1 MtCO2/yr packed-bed slab contactor)

air_velocity_m_s.note: Face velocity of air through packing (Holmes & Keith 2012)

KgA_contactor.note: Volumetric mass-transfer coefficient Kg*a for CO2 into 1M KOH; sets single-pass capture (Holmes & Keith 2012)

V_solution_m3.note: Lumped hydroxide solution hold-up in contactor sump

OH_conc_mol_m3.note: Hydroxide concentration ~1 M KOH (large excess vs dilute CO2)

m_calciner_kg.note: Calciner + circulating CaCO3/CaO solids thermal mass

T_calciner_K.note: Calciner operating temperature (~900C) for CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2

T_calciner_setpoint_K.note: Target calciner temperature held by burner

dH_calcination_J_mol.note: Endothermic enthalpy of CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2 (178 kJ/mol)

A_calc_pre.note: Arrhenius pre-exponential for lumped calcination rate

Ea_calc_J_mol.note: Activation energy for CaCO3 decomposition (~165 kJ/mol)

T_flame_K.note: Effective burner/flame temperature driving heat into calciner

heat_loss_frac.note: Wall + flue-gas heat loss as fraction of burner duty

T_feed_solids_K.note: Temperature of CaCO3 pellets entering calciner (~300C after preheat)

loop_efficiency.note: Fraction of contactor-captured CO2 that survives causticization+slaking and reaches the calciner
